# developer-ai.txt Specification (ADF-009)
# https://www.ai-visibility.org.uk/specifications/developer-ai-txt/
# Generated by build/ai-discovery.mjs (AI Discovery Files spec layout, v2.2.2)
# Technical Context - Mohd Elfie Nieshaem Juferi

Lang: en
Website: [https://menj.buzz/](https://menj.buzz/)
Last Updated: 2026-10-06

## Platform

- Static site, no CMS and no database
- Language: en
- Character Set: UTF-8

## Technology Stack

- Flat-file JSON content in data/
- Node build script (build/render.mjs) rendering static HTML
- Tailwind CSS compiled at build time
- Vanilla JavaScript, no framework
- Self-hosted woff2 fonts, no third-party requests

## Developer Notes

- Every page is served as static HTML; nothing is assembled in the browser except the blog feed.
- Structured data is a single JSON-LD @graph per page, generated from the same JSON that fills the page.
- External identifiers are pulled from menj.bio/identity.json at build time.

## Data Feeds

- [Blog (WordPress REST)](https://menj.blog/wp-json/wp/v2/posts)
- [Archive library index (YAML)](https://menj.bio/library.yaml)
- [Archive identity record](https://menj.bio/identity.json)
